landmarks.name: Shinjuku Station
landmarks.hint: The world's busiest railway station, surrounded by skyscrapers and a sprawling nightlife district

landmarks.name: Tokyo Tower
landmarks.hint: A red-and-white lattice communications tower modelled after the Eiffel Tower

landmarks.name: Tokyo Skytree
landmarks.hint: The world's tallest broadcasting tower, rising over the old shitamachi district

landmarks.name: Tsukiji Outer Market
landmarks.hint: A famous seafood market that once handled the world's largest tuna auctions

landmarks.name: Imperial Palace
landmarks.hint: The primary residence of Japan's Emperor, surrounded by moats and ancient stone walls in the city centre

landmarks.name: Ueno Park
landmarks.hint: A large public park housing Japan's oldest zoo and several major national museums

landmarks.name: Shibuya Crossing
landmarks.hint: The world's busiest pedestrian scramble intersection, surrounded by giant video screens

landmarks.name: Akihabara
landmarks.hint: A district famous for multi-storey electronics shops, anime, and manga culture

landmarks.name: Tokyo Disneyland
landmarks.hint: The first Disney theme park to open outside the United States, built on reclaimed bay land

landmarks.name: Senso-ji Temple
landmarks.hint: Tokyo's oldest Buddhist temple, approached through a gate hung with a giant paper lantern
